fieldValues.title: 4. Effort: size and complexity
fieldValues.thinking_reached: srs-rust: size small, medium, large, xl and size:XS; complexity simple, medium, complex and also low, small, high. srs, srs-vscode, semanticops.com, muDemocracy.org: size small to xl; complexity simple, medium, complex. srs-web: size small to xl plus size:m; complexity simple, medium, complex, high. clerk, srs-programme, srs-context: size only. clerk board size sets small, medium, large or xl.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Six complexity labels for three levels in srs-rust; srs-web adds high.
- size:XS and size:m use different spellings from the other sizes.
- 'small' appears in both size and complexity.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Is complexity used for anything the derived priority or queue reads?
fieldValues.next_action: Collapse to one size scale and one complexity scale (quick win, proposed).
